articles.title: Oops! The New Live-Action Moana Sinks Like a Coconut
articles.summary: Disney’s new live-action Moana got a 33% on Rotten Tomatoes — almost as low as a sinking canoe! Critics say it feels fake and lifeless, with one even calling Dwayne Johnson’s wig a low point. Ouch!

articles.title: A 250-Year Secret Buried Under a Giant Snake!
articles.summary: America’s 250th birthday time capsule is packed with wild treasures — a diamond, a whale bone, an eagle feather, and an AI prediction! It’s sealed so well it could survive underwater, and a giant snake sculpture marks the spot.

articles.title: From Nowhere to Wimbledon Hero: Arthur Fery’s Magic Run!
articles.summary: British wildcard Arthur Fery, ranked 114th, shocked world No. 10 Cobolli to reach the Wimbledon semi-finals! He’s the first wildcard in 25 years to do it. The crowd chanted his name as he fell to the ground in joy.
